name: Alarm Icon
description: Filled alarm clock icon with multiple animation variations

variations.name: default
variations.description: The alarm rocks left and right like a ringing bell, with ears counter-rotating to sell the physics

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Fill color of the icon (CSS color value)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the SVG element

props.name: isHovered
props.description: Triggers the ring animation. Manage this state in the parent via onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave.

variations.name: tick
variations.description: The clock hand sweeps a full clockwise rotation on click, like dialing an alarm to confirm it's set

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Fill color of the icon (CSS color value)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the SVG element

props.name: isAnimating
props.description: Triggers the hand sweep externally. The icon also fires the animation on direct click.

props.name: onAnimationComplete
props.description: Callback fired after the hand completes its full sweep.
